subject.title: [Bug]: Discord media uploads lose content-type and animated images lose frames

question: Should maintainers continue repairing the linked open PR as the canonical fix, or replace it with a narrower current-main PR for the Discord MIME/WebP media bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the active linked PR has maintainer-facing proof and contract blockers, so automation should not queue a parallel fix or close the tracker before a human chooses the landing path.

options.title: Repair the linked PR
options.body: Keep the linked PR canonical, refresh it on current main, resolve the proof/contract blockers there, and close this issue only after merge.

options.title: Replace with a narrower PR
options.body: Close or supersede the stale branch only after a fresh narrow PR preserves contributor credit and covers all affected Discord upload paths.

options.title: Wait for contributor proof
options.body: Leave the issue and linked PR open until the contributor adds redacted live Discord proof, accepting slower resolution.

recommendation.title: Repair the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep the linked PR canonical, refresh it on current main, resolve the proof/contract blockers there, and close this issue only after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across the current Discord send and media-loader lines plus adjacent public-contract review surfaces.
